reason: I have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years and see no reason to pay ₹12,990 upfront for unfamiliar software. Until a tool proves it is dead simple and won't disrupt our established routine, I would only ever test the free pilot.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder, and will learning another platform just add more hassle than my Saturday spreadsheets?
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free pilot and seeing it eliminate my 2-hour Saturday GST reconciliation while proving that assistants cannot accidentally delete or displace Drive folders.
